entities.summary: Warren M. Anderson was an American businessman who was the chair and CEO of the Union Carbide Corporation (UCC) at the time of the Bhopal disaster in 1984. In 1989, UCC paid $479 million to the Indian government to settle litigation stemming from the disaster.
